limitations: Use complete native European ion-exchange softened water per signed kg of source softened water. Source regional markets supply one kg of local ion-exchange production with no delivery losses or transport. Native process includes decarbonised feedwater (1.05 kg/kg), chemicals, internal freight and wastewater. These internal quantities replace the source treatment model; do not apply an extra water-loss, density, solution or delivery multiplier.

Source includes regeneration chemicals, electricity, treatment infrastructure and wastewater. Native estimated power-plant cooling-water treatment uses different chemicals, feedwater, wastewater, emissions, technology detail, regional background and vintage. Complete native upstream inputs and treatment remain; no omitted caller emissions or invented water-balance correction. Score effects are unquantified.

Preserve signed caller kg, formulas, uncertainty and exchange ownership. This approval covers only the inspected ecoinvent 3.6 cut-off source profile; no consequential, reverse or other-version approval and no whole capture-chain or heat-role qualification.

Source market group contains CH and Europe-without-Switzerland delivery markets at shares 0.0618560532327723 and 0.938143946767228. The native refinery mix, delivery transport, tank infrastructure, evaporation and effluent/disposal model replace those markets, including source imported/recycled fuel shares and allocation.

Both cover refinery-to-user distribution, not combustion. Keep complete native fuel production, storage and delivery once. Retain separately listed caller transport, operating fuel and emissions. No extra freight, refinery burden, tank, energy/LHV or density multiplier. Geography, technology, fuel properties, vintage, uncertainty and score effects differ and remain unquantified.
